text:
sophia: Heads-up — noticed a ~15% drop in prefix cache hit-rate on prod after yesterday's kernel-selector change. Dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/prompt-cache?range=24h. Anyone tracking?

mike: @sophia saw the spike too. Initial traces point to the fallback kernel path skipping key-normalizer which causes different key encodings (so cache miss). Adding verbose logs now.

raj: I pushed a quick patch to re-enable the key-normalizer for fallback kernels (PR #4321). Need to run a few replays to confirm regression fixed.

sophia: Any SLO impact or customer-facing errors? token-saved numbers?

laura: No customer errors. Latency: p50 up ~30ms on affected routes, p95 up ~80ms. Token-saved dropped ~120k tokens/hour across top 10 routes. Perf trace: https://perf-traces.internal/trace/5a3b2c

evan: Sampling snippet from replay: ```json
{"route":"/chat","model":"mosaic-1.2","kernel":"fallback","kv_hit":false,"prefix_len":48}
``` Suggest adding a unit test that asserts KeyNormalizer idempotency for boundary trimming.

mike: If patch blocks landing tonight, plan B is to revert kernel-selector config on Monday morning. Also can we add a metric `runtime.kv_prefix_mismatch_count`? @deploy-bot can you wire an alert for this?

deploy-bot: alert created -> name: runtime.kv_prefix_mismatch_count.alert, condition: count >= 50 over 5m, notify: oncall-engineering.

raj: Replayed 2M requests locally with batching heuristics toggled. When batch_size > 8 we see increased collisions — root cause looks like the boundary-trim logic drops trailing whitespace differently in some kernels, changing hash. Repro steps gist: https://gist.github.com/raj/replay-keying-steps.

laura: For dashboards: propose new panels — (1) per-model prefix hit-rate, (2) per-route token-saved delta vs baseline, (3) per-customer 24h hit-rate change. Example query sketch: `sum(tokens_saved) by (route,model,customer) - baseline(tokens_saved, 7d)`

sophia: :thumbsup: Also want a warmup strategy runbook: during scale-up prefetch top-N prefixes per tenant. Start experiments N={50,200} with 1h windows to measure cost vs yield.

evan: I'll run a 10% canary tomorrow: patch + key-normalizer + batching cutoff at 8. Will post results in this thread with the dashboard links.

mike: Action items -> raj: add tests + push patch; laura: add dashboard panels & create alert; evan: run canary and attach traces; sophia: coordinate postmortem + writeup if needed. I'll create GH issue and assign owners.

sophia: Thanks. Please paste PR/issue links here when ready.
